indicators.label: Church of Denmark members
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field name used for the administrative Church of Denmark membership count. The value is not census religious affiliation, attendance, belief, or all-religion membership.
indicators.method: StatBank FKMED F, member of the National Church.
indicators.quality_notes: Administrative Church of Denmark membership register population: member plus not-member counts in the same StatBank table, geography, and January/Q1 period.

indicators.label: Church of Denmark member share
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary percent field used for Church of Denmark membership share. The percentage is 100 times member divided by member plus non-member in the same source row.
indicators.quality_notes: Administrative Church of Denmark membership register population: member plus not-member counts in the same StatBank table, geography, and January/Q1 period.

indicators.label: Not Church of Denmark members
indicators.description: Legacy no-religion count field used for persons not registered as Church of Denmark members. The value is not a no-religion identity measure.
indicators.method: StatBank FKMED U, not member of the National Church.
indicators.quality_notes: Administrative Church of Denmark membership register population: member plus not-member counts in the same StatBank table, geography, and January/Q1 period.

indicators.label: Not Church of Denmark member share
indicators.description: Legacy no-religion percent field used for the share not registered as Church of Denmark members. It is not a no-religion affiliation measure.
indicators.quality_notes: Administrative Church of Denmark membership register population: member plus not-member counts in the same StatBank table, geography, and January/Q1 period.
